privileged_info_for_vlm: The source file is sip-rtp-g711.pcap. The expected output is a Sun Audio file (.au) located at ~/Documents/captures/recovered_call.au. A successful extraction of this specific PCAP should result in a file approximately 144,508 bytes in size.
